arguments.command: bd remember 'Meridian Credits release "1.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, per issue trial-4tt). Applies to every monthly statement quote under release 1.0; omitted release selects the current agreement, explicit supported release selects that version. Rules: (1) uncapped line credit = 10% of charge_cents, floored per line to integer cents; (2) credit cap 2400 cents shared by all lines with the same account_id across its subscriptions, independent per account; (3) within a cap group, priority = earliest service_on first, ties by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order); each line gets its uncapped credit up to the remaining cap, later lines get the remainder or zero; (4) total credit = sum of line credits; line amount_due = charge - credit; total due = total charges - total credit. Data model: line has exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on (YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01..2099-12-31), charge_cents (nonneg int); subscription key is (account_id, subscription_id); caps apply within one request. Quote command: {"command":"quote","line":LINE[,"release":"1.0"]} -> exactly {release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents}; single line is treated as the whole statement. Implementation: main.py assign_credits() runs the cap/priority engine for a list of lines. Public suite: python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/release_1_quote.json.' --key 'meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement' 2>&1; bd close trial-4tt 2>&1
arguments.description: Save agreement memory and close issue
